title: Looking to play around with Unreal Engine. What is the best code assist is the best deal currently?
author: Novel-Initiative-900
selftext:
I just want to get my feet wet and try / learn ai game dev, just experiment a little. 

What would the best deal right now be? I currently have only used Gemini for CRUD applications in antigravity and I've never tried doing anything in game dev. I hear Gemini is not great for this. 

Is Codex the best deal right now? 

I also MCP to all the models on Ollama for other simple dev stuff I've been doing in antigravity but I'm not sure if there's open source models good for game dev. 

So what's worth spending just a little bit of money on? 

Thanks for any opinions:)

comments.author: enozian
comments.body: [https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/unreal-mcp-in-unreal-editor?lang=en-US](https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/unreal-mcp-in-unreal-editor?lang=en-US), the absolute best bang for your buck is $100-$200 plans at openai/anthropic. if you are below those price points maybe put $5-$10 into openrouter to give you enough budget to try frontier open weight models like kimi k3, glm 5.3, mimo 3, gemini, etc.. and once you have an idea of what suits you there is a subscription plan that might subsidize your usage a bit
